## Verification Quality

- [x] CHK027 Are acceptance criteria measurable for zero no-consent network requests, credential absence, package offline behavior, and source-folder preservation? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004, Spec §SC-007, Spec §SC-010]

## Research Notes

- File System Access folder selection requires transient user activation and can fail with security-related exceptions; requirements keep picker/reconnect behind user actions and capability reports.
- OPFS is origin-private browser storage; site-data clearing deletes it and quota applies, so delete and recovery requirements stay browser-owned and source-folder-neutral.
- SQLite-Wasm's OPFS SAH-pool is the documented high-performance option that avoids COOP/COEP dependency while running in worker contexts.
- React treats raw HTML assignment as dangerous for untrusted content; the existing source pane renders source via text nodes, but SPEC-007 needed an explicit requirement for malicious browser-local source rendering.
